title: Changing the Vehicle on File under a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
## Rule

A tenant may replace the vehicle on file for a parking space with a different vehicle that fits the space class, at most the swap allowance of the space class times in any rolling 365-day window, and each such swap posts a vehicle swap fee. This applies to every class of the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.

A different vehicle is not put on file until the agreement stands in active status.

The vehicle put on file must be of a type the space class allows and no longer than the class's maximum length, as the tenant reads its type and overall length from the vehicle's registration. The plate and the registration and insurance expiry dates of the vehicle put on file are recorded exactly as the tenant reads them from the registration card and the insurance card.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Standing of the agreement | The agreement stands in active status when the different vehicle is put on file |
| Fit | Type allowed by the class; overall length no longer than the class maximum; both as read by the tenant from the registration |
| Details recorded | Plate, registration expiry and insurance expiry exactly as the tenant reads them from the cards |
| Allowance | At most the class's swap allowance in any rolling 365-day window |
| Fee | Each swap posts a vehicle swap fee |

## Putting the vehicle on file: `swap_parking_vehicle_d3106476`

**Capability.** Puts a different vehicle on file for a parking agreement and posts the vehicle swap fee: the vehicle type, overall length, plate and the registration and insurance expiry dates on file are replaced with the new vehicle's details, and one fee entry of the kind "vehicle swap fee", dated today with today as its request date, is added to the agreement's ledger, raising the balance due by the fee. The tenant sees the new vehicle on file and the fee on the ledger at once.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the care agent unlocks `swap_parking_vehicle_d3106476` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `parking_rental_id` — the parking agreement number whose vehicle on file is replaced, as returned by the parking agreement lookup for this tenant (identifier).
- `vehicle_type` — the type of the new vehicle, one of: `car_or_pickup` (passenger car, SUV or pickup truck); `motorcycle` (motorcycle or scooter); `utility_trailer` (open or enclosed utility trailer); `boat_on_trailer` (boat kept on its trailer); `travel_trailer` (bumper-pull travel trailer); `fifth_wheel` (fifth-wheel trailer); `class_a_motorhome` (bus-style motorhome); `class_b_motorhome` (camper van); `class_c_motorhome` (cab-over motorhome on a truck chassis).
- `vehicle_length_ft` — the new vehicle's overall length including any tongue or outboard motor, an integer number of feet as the tenant reads it from the registration.
- `vehicle_plate` — the new vehicle's plate number exactly as the tenant reads it from the registration card, copied character for character with no spacing or letter changes (verbatim).
- `registration_expiry` — the expiry date printed on the new vehicle's registration, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `insurance_expiry` — the expiry date printed on the new vehicle's liability insurance card, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `swap_fee` — the vehicle swap fee in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places; stored rounded half-up to the cent exactly as given.

**Return.** The call is complete when the receipt comes back with `parking_rental_id`, `vehicle_type`, `vehicle_length_ft` (feet), `vehicle_plate`, `registration_expiry` and `insurance_expiry` (YYYY-MM-DD) — the vehicle now on file — and `fee_entry_id` (the new ledger entry number), `fee_type` (always `vehicle_swap_fee`), `swap_fee` (USD with 2 decimal places as booked), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `balance_due` (USD with 2 decimal places, the resulting balance due; negative means a credit balance).
